summary: ADR-0050 accepted 2026-07-29; formal LKG recovery only via publish_knowledge_catalog.py --restore-lkg; recovery uses single-writer lock and validates LKG pointer, generation identity, artifact hashes, source snapshot, policy, query report, and current main; older LKG allowed only if ancestor and all inputs byte-match main; restores source snapshot plus v2 Catalog, projections, v1 compatibility Catalog; revalidates publication, Locator gate, canonical smoke; stale LKG never overrides newer main; failures roll back and verify four layers and pointers; publication activation is one rollback domain with current pointer last; control-plane scripts must match pinned main; stale lock recovery rules include PID/process identity, 60-second grace for malformed locks; pruning is separate explicit prune_knowledge_generations.py --prune; protects current, LKG, and five newest valid successful generations; mtime not authoritative; invalid/uncommitted/unrecognized generations retained and reported; pruning requires canonical policy, intent, per-generation authorization, atomic isolation, and evidence; append-only failure logs excluded; extends ADR-0048, complements ADR-0044, supersedes neither; retention policy versioned and ADR-governed
